title: What a virtual machine is and what it saves you

videos.script: A virtual machine is a computer made of software. It runs inside a real one, which we call the host. {{host}} From inside, it looks like any other computer. It has processors, memory, a disk and a network card. It boots, you log in, you install things. {{inside}} From outside, on the host, it is a program that is running, and a file on the disk. {{outside}} That changes what you can afford to do with it. You can make one in a minute. You can break it on purpose and throw it away. You can keep ten on one laptop, each a different system. {{uses}} This course is done on your own computer, so this lesson starts by building the lab there: the programs, a base disk, and the small disk that tells a new guest its name. Then you will make a guest by hand, look at it from both sides, switch it off and on, destroy its system from inside, and delete it. The host will not notice. {{lab}} At the end, one script that makes every later guest in one command, what to do when the setup fails, and what a guest costs, because memory, disk and processor time all come from the host. {{cost}}
